verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM claims "no frustrating setup required", and hands-on users report a single-install desktop app that non-technical people had running in minutes, with Ollama models auto-detected and manual setup still available. That points to UI-driven model setup rather than config-file editing, but no first-run wizard is actually documented. missing for 10: an explicitly documented first-run onboarding wizard, guided entry of model credentials/API keys, any channel setup step, guided selection of defaults (embedder, vector store), and first-party docs describing the onboarding flow.

support.subject: As an everyday user, a first-run wizard walks me through model credentials, channels, and defaults instead of hand-editing config files

citations.quote: hyper-configurable, multi-user, & no frustrating setup required
With Ollama, everything was automatically detected, while manual setup is still possible.
this has been the only offline AI tool I've been able to install and start using on my standard office PC.
